_evidence: 256-byte table read only by 0x52bd00 ('movzx eax,al; add eax,0x81dc63; cmp byte [eax],0xff; je' -> clc/stc): index al is any byte, the entry only decides CF (== 0xff -> CF=0, else CF=1). It is writable .data; every entry is drawn from {0xff (twice), 0, 1, 0x7f, 0xfe} so both CF outcomes occur for any setting value instead of depending on the image's pattern. Any byte is a valid entry for the reader.
